_help: Settings of the analyse-and-plan-ticket skill. Do not edit this shipped copy: a plugin update replaces it.

Put your own values in ~/.claude/sdlc-core/ticket-analysis.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.claude\sdlc-core\ticket-analysis.json); a key there replaces the same key here. A project profile (.sdlc/project.json -> ticketAnalysis) overrides both.

templateSet: which set of templates writes the two files. Folders under templates/analysis/: standard (short, 8 sections each) or detailed (adds stakeholders, non-functional requirements, traceability, task breakdown, rollout and a definition of done). Add your own folder and name it for what it is, for example 'security-review'.
files: the names of the two files. {key} is the ticket key. Keep the names meaningful: they are what people see on the ticket.
outputDir: where the files are written. Empty means the ticket folder of the profile (.sdlc/tickets/<KEY>/), or .sdlc/tickets/<KEY>/ in the current folder when there is no profile.
ccGeneralAssignee: true = the Jira comment starts with 'CC:' and a real @mention of the general assignee (generalAssignee in ticket-creation.json). The mention is a Jira user tag, never plain text.
maxCommentChars: a Jira comment holds about 32000 characters; longer content is split into two comments (analysis, then plan).
attachFiles: true = also attach the two .md files to the ticket when an API token is configured; otherwise they are in the comment and kept locally.
